protocols.name: X3DH
constraints: The prekey bundle and identity binding MUST be verified as specified by X3DH.
A used one-time prekey private key MUST be deleted after successful session establishment.
The post-X3DH protocol MUST randomize the responder's encryption key before responder encrypted data is sent, preventing catastrophic key reuse after replay.

protocols.name: PQXDH
constraints: A post-quantum KEM with IND-CCA post-quantum security MUST be selected by the consuming profile.
The prekey bundle, signatures, identity binding, and KEM re-encapsulation mitigations MUST follow PQXDH.
Current PQXDH authentication is classical and MUST NOT be represented as post-quantum authentication.
A used one-time prekey private key and any applicable one-time post-quantum prekey private key MUST be deleted as specified.

protocols.name: Double Ratchet
constraints: Message keys and superseded chain or ratchet state MUST be deleted according to the specification.
Skipped message keys MUST be bounded to prevent unbounded storage or denial-of-service.
The initialization shared secret and associated data MUST be bound according to the selected initialization protocol.

protocols.name: Sparse Post-Quantum Ratchet with ML-KEM Braid
protocols.specification: Signal Double Ratchet Revision 4, Section 5 with ML-KEM Braid
constraints: The SCKA instantiation MUST be ML-KEM Braid when this registry identifier is selected.
Past epoch state and message keys MUST be deleted according to the specification.
Implementations MUST account for the effect of dropped messages on post-compromise healing.

protocols.name: Triple Ratchet
constraints: The classical Double Ratchet and Sparse Post-Quantum Ratchet MUST both run and their message-key outputs MUST be combined as specified.
The SCKA component MUST be ML-KEM Braid for the E2EESA 0.1 profile.
Removing either ratchet component changes the protocol and MUST require a different profile identifier.

protocols.name: Sesame
constraints: Session-management use MUST remain subordinate to the selected pairwise encryption profile and current authorized device set.
A session manager MUST NOT re-authorize a device revoked by the identity architecture.
